title: [Decision] Should an approver be able to see and decide their pending approvals over MCP?
body:
Filing category: ② a decision only the maintainer can make.
Batch-of: 15 cards filed together from one MCP capability test session (2026-11-11; 6 in cloud, 9 in objectstack).

## 维护者速读

- 现象：申请人能通过 MCP 提交请假，审批流程（`approval` 节点）也能正常生成 `sys_approval_request`；但审批人那一侧在 MCP 上没有任何入口：`list_actions` 里没有审批动作，`sys_approval_request` 不在 `list_objects` 里，同意/驳回只能回到界面或 REST。
- 要你裁：审批人的「看待办 + 同意/驳回」是否进入 MCP，以及走哪个形状。
- 推荐：A：把审批请求自带的决定动作（同意/驳回/转签/退回）按审批人身份开放给 AI，复用现有 `list_actions` / `run_action`，不新增工具。

## One-sentence problem

An agent can file a leave request for its user but cannot act for the manager who has to approve it, so half of every approval process stays outside MCP.

## Evidence (reach)

Hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack`, Team plan; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`): an MCP-authored flow with an `approval` node (`org_membership_level: owner`) published; `create_record` over MCP opened `sys_approval_request` `pending` naming the owner. Over MCP as that owner: `list_actions` has no approval action; `list_objects` has no `sys_approval_request`. The decision was only possible via `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/approve` (the console's 通过 button), after which the flow resumed and the record read `approved`.

## Governing text

- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` — "Two kinds of user: today, business staff through the UI …; tomorrow, agents through MCP. Every step of the road must hold for both kinds of user." The road includes "approvals and automation".
- `packages/mcp/README.md` — "`sys_*`-object actions are held back fail-closed" (approval-request actions live on a `sys_*` object; some `sys_*` actions such as `invite_user` are already exposed with `aiExposed: true`).

## Options

| Option | What it does | What the customer sees | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Expose the approval request's own decide actions (approve / reject / reassign / send back) with `ai.exposed`, gated to the request's current approvers; let an approver read their pending requests through the existing record tools | "Approve Zhang San's leave" works from Claude; same gates as the console button | approvals + mcp seats · 1–2 PRs · precedent: `sys_user` actions exposed via `aiExposed` (no PR number measured) |
| B | Add dedicated MCP tools (`list_my_approvals`, `decide_approval`) | Same capability, a separate tool family | mcp seat · 1–2 PRs · no precedent |
| C | Keep approvals UI-only | Agents submit, humans decide in the console | none |

Business reading: A = the approval inbox is just more actions an agent can take for its user; B = approvals get their own agent API; C = approvals are deliberately a human-only step.

## Recommendation

A. Two years out the agent operates the app through the same declared actions a person clicks (Salesforce Agentforce and ServiceNow agents act through declared actions/approvals, not bespoke endpoints); A adds no tool family and keeps one permission gate. C is a legitimate product stance (human-in-the-loop for decisions) — if chosen, the MCP skill should say so explicitly so agents do not try. Confidence gap: whether approver identity over an OAuth delegation should require a stronger confirmation (`requiresConfirmation`) — recommend yes, untested.
Self-check: only ① picks A; ②③④ do not flip it.

## After the ruling

A: approvals seat exposes the decide actions with approver-scoped gates + `requiresConfirmation`; mcp seat lets `list_actions` include them for the approver; e2e: submit over MCP as user A, decide over MCP as approver B, record resumes.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A 复用「动作」作为 agent 唯一操作面，不新增工具族，缩小特例；B 扩大契约面。
② 实际业务拉动: 今天任何「请假/报销/采购」审批场景用 MCP 走全程都会在审批人这一步断开（本次实测）。
③ 防 AI 犯错: A 下审批走与界面同一个带审批人校验的动作；无入口时 agent 会去改状态字段，绕过审批。
④ 创业阶段不扩散: A 不新增工具；C 零成本但留下 North Star 缺口。
Prior rulings read: "approval mcp approver decide tool" → 128 hits (top: #30806, #27101, #28657; none rule on MCP decisions); ADR-0011; thread: none

Reader who acts: the approvals seat and the `packages/mcp` seat, after the ruling.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue approval mcp approver decide tool` → 128 hits, none on approver-side MCP access; cloud `approver mcp approval tool` → 12 hits (cloud#3600 scenario epic, cloud#4091 AI write hold, cloud#3301 lint), none.
